The server never sees your password, so nobody, including whoever runs this server, can reset it for you. After you register you'll get a recovery code: it's the only way to set a new password without losing your data.
login.understood: I understand that if I lose both my password and my recovery code, my data can't be recovered.

kit.step1: Open the HelixSync sign-in page at the server address above.
kit.step3: Enter your account email and this recovery code, then pick a new password.
kit.warning: Each code works once: you get a new one after using it. Keep this kit offline and private; anyone with it and your email can reset your password and read your synced data.

security.title: Security
security.encryptionRequired: End-to-end encryption is required for this account. The server cannot read your synchronized browser data.
security.encryptionNotRequired: This server is not enforcing end-to-end encryption, so it would accept unencrypted data (REQUIRE_ENCRYPTION is off). Your devices still encrypt what they sync, but nothing on the server stops a client that doesn't. This setup is only appropriate for local development — see docs/encryption.md.
security.changePasswordInfo: Your data stays readable across a password change: the encryption key itself doesn't change, it's just re-secured under your new password (docs/encryption.md §2). Every device just needs to sign in again to pick it up — nothing needs to be reconnected or re-synced. Changing your password also signs out every other browser session on this account.
security.recoveryInfo: Your recovery code lets you set a new password from the sign-in page if you forget yours, without losing your data. Generate a new one if you lost it or think someone else has seen it; the old code stops working right away.
security.wrongPasswordRecovery: That password is incorrect. Your recovery code was not changed.
security.passkeyInfo: A passkey (fingerprint, OS PIN, phone or security key) can unlock your recovery code if you lose the printed copy. The sealed code stays in this browser and in a rescue file that is useless without your passkey. The passkey is tied to this site's address, and your recovery code stays the baseline.
security.dangerInfo: Deleting your account permanently removes everything stored on this server: your devices, all synced bookmarks, history and tabs, and every session. It can't be undone, and because your data is encrypted with a key only your password unlocks, it can't be recovered afterwards either. Browsers that are still connected simply stop syncing.
security.wrongPasswordDelete: That password is incorrect. Nothing was deleted.

restore.title: Restore points
restore.unsupported: This server doesn't support restore points yet.
restore.intro: Saved, encrypted copies of your bookmarks. To restore one, open the HelixSync extension in your browser: restoring needs your account key, which this page never has.
restore.automaticHelp: A daily copy, plus one before a restore, a first import, a full resync, or a large deletion. Pin a point to keep it; unpinned ones are removed first when space runs out or after the retention period.
restore.deleteConfirm: Delete the restore point from {{date}}? This can't be undone.
